title: Qaid khane se sakina ki ye aati thi sada
body:
Qaid khane se sakina ki ye aati thi sada
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye sakina, haaye sakina
haye sakina
Haye...haaye...
Samajh ke zahra sataya gaya sakina ko
qadam qadam pe rulaya gaya sakina ko
wo zakhm aaj bhi taaza hai pushte naaqa se
haye giri nahi hai giraya gaya sakina ko
haye... haye
<<MINI>>
Qaid khane se sakina ki ye aati thi sada
pasliya'n toot gayi meri bhi dadi ki tarha
<<DIVIDER>>
Mujhko chalte hue naaqe se giraya baba

1. Wo bhi dada se chupati rahi apna pehlu
mujhse bhi dekhe na jayenge ali ke aasu..(2)
jeeteji mere mera zakhm na dekhe bhaiyya
<<MINI>>
pasliya'n toot gayi meri bhi dadi ki tarha

2. Kaise aayi hu mai bazaar se hokar baba
mujhko maare gaye is zakhm pe patthar baba..(2)
roke mai kehti rahi phir bhi kisi ne na suna
<<MINI>>
pasliya'n toot gayi meri bhi dadi ki tarha

3. Haye, Ab samajh sakti hu kis tarha wo soti hongi
haath pehlu pe rakhe kaise tadapti hongi
karwate dard mujhe bhi nahi lene deta
<<MINI>>
pasliya'n toot gayi meri bhi dadi ki tarha
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Hubahu fatima zehra si zaeefi chayi
jhurriya'n chehre pe baalo mein safedi aayi..(2)
ek kami baaqi thi wo bhi hui poori baba
<<MINI>>
pasliya'n toot gayi meri bhi dadi ki tarha
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Saath suraj ke ye dil doob raha hota hai
amma kehti hai yehi waqt e dua hota hai..(2)
roz karti hu sare shaam mai marne ki dua
<<MINI>>
pasliya'n toot gayi meri bhi dadi ki tarha
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Jaake jannat mein bhi aaram nahi payega
kya ye armaan mera dil mein hi reh jayega
kaise godi mein uthaungi mai asghar ko bhala
<<MINI>>
pasliya'n toot gayi meri bhi dadi ki tarha
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Aapka sar jale daaman mein uthane ke liye
haath darbaar mein mushkil se uthaye maine
tumko us waqt bhi maine na bataya baba
<<MINI>>
pasliya'n toot gayi meri bhi dadi ki tarha
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Gir padi khaak pe namoos e nabi peet ke sarr
qaid khane mein hui aur qayamat akbar
leke sar baap ka bachhi ne jo ro ro ke kaha
<<MINI>>
pasliya'n toot gayi meri bhi dadi ki tarha
